Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2.  The present petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.PC seeking quashing of the FIR No.0496/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Najafgarh, Delhi on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement.
3. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.

4. Learned APP submits that since the present FIR has arisen out of matrimonial dispute and the parties have amicably settled all their disputes, the State has no objection in case, the present FIR is quashed.
5. The petitioner no.1 (husband), petitioner no.2 (mother of the petitioner no.1), petitioner no.3 (father of the petitioner no.1) and petitioner This is a digitally signed order.

6. Learned counsel for the parties submits that on account of temperamental differences, certain disputes arose between the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2, which led to registration of the Sukhmahender & Ors vs State Of Gnct Of Delhi & Anr on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69958490/

sentences.text: Respondent no.2, who is present in the Court today submits that the disputes with the petitioners have been resolved and she has now been residing with the petitioner no.1 for the last one year and she has no objection in case the FIR in question is quashed.

8. The petition is supported by the affidavits of the petitioners as well as the respondent no.2.
9.
In view of the fact that parties have started living together, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the criminal proceedings.
10. There is also no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.
Accordingly, FIR No.0496/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Najafgarh, Delhi and all other proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
11. The petition is disposed of.
12. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J MAY 19, 2023 MK
